lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regularly spaced vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, forming a grid-like arrangement across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity that align with and intersect the primary circular spot centroids, creating a lattice pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from a light upper edge to a shadowed lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense clustering of smaller, lower-intensity white spots localized on the dorsal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
